shortDescription: Module to interact with rapyuta_io secrets

options.name: authentication_type
options.description: There are 2 types of authentication types for source secrets in rapyuta.io. If I(authentication_type=ssh) then C(ssh_key) option is required. If I(authentication_type=ssh=basic) then C(executable_type) option is required.

options.name: password
options.description: Required if I(type=docker) secrets or I(type=source) when I(authentication_type=basic) and I(executable_type=password).

options.name: present
options.description: Whether the secret should be present in rapyuta.io.

options.name: source_token
options.description: Required if I(type=docker) secrets or I(type=source) when I(authentication_type=basic) and I(executable_type=source_token).

options.name: ssh_key
options.description: Required if I(authentication_type=ssh) for I(type=source) secrets. ssh_key can be given to authenticate to a private source control repository.

options.name: type
options.description: There are 2 types of secrets in rapyuta.io. If I(type=docker) then C(username), C(password), C(email) option are required. C(registry) is by default dockerhub, but a custom registry can be used. If I(type=source) then C(authentication_type) option is required. Source secrets allow the user to pull in code from private Source control repository. Docker secrets allow the user to pull the docker image from private image registry.

options.name: username
options.description: Required if I(type=docker) secrets or I(type=source) when I(authentication_type=basic) and I(executable_type=password).
